-- TX-19: D = Kyle Rable (uncontested, already clean); R runoff = Tom Sell vs. Abraham Enriquez
UPDATE house_races
SET candidate1_name = 'Kyle Rable',
    candidate1_party = 'D',
    candidate2_name = 'Tom Sell',
    candidate2_party = 'R',
    status = 'Primary Runoff',
    notes = 'R primary runoff May 26: Tom Sell vs. Abraham Enriquez. D nominee: Kyle Rable (uncontested).'
WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district = 19;
